title: The product is called Mainworks wherever a person reads its name
description: A real browser opens the sign-in page, the home page and an invite link: the visible text and the tab title say Mainworks and never Mainworks. Both command names, mainworks and mainworks, run the same CLI: --help and guide exit 0 with Mainworks help text and mainworks usage lines.
